ownWay:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Builds an n by n coordinate maze, records the path described by s, then randomly shuffles s until the shuffled path shares no same-position directed edge with the original path, and prints the accepted shuffled path string." ownWay]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> s </REF>: string "Direction string made of 'S' and 'E' characters representing the original path."
        <REF> n </REF>: integer "Dimension of the square maze; the path contains 2*n - 2 moves."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Build the n by n maze matrix: for each i in range(n), append a row; for each j in range(n), append a cell list; and for k in range(2), append i when k == 0 and append j when k == 1, so every maze[i][j] equals [i, j]. RESULT maze]
            [COMMAND Convert s to a list of characters named l, and initialize c_l as a zero-filled nested list with shape 1 x (2*n - 1) x 2 using three nested loops over range(1), range(2*n - 1), and range(2). RESULT c_l]
            [COMMAND Set x = 0 and y = 0, then store the starting maze cell in c_l[0][0] by assigning c_l[0][0][0] = maze[x][y][0] and c_l[0][0][1] = maze[x][y][1]. RESULT c_l]
            [COMMAND For i from 0 through 2*n - 3 inclusive, update the position using l[i]: if l[i] is 'S', increment y and copy maze[x][y] into c_l[0][i+1]; if l[i] is 'E', increment x and copy maze[x][y] into c_l[0][i+1]. RESULT c_l]
            [COMMAND Set check = True, then shuffle the list l in place with random.shuffle(l). RESULT l]
            [COMMAND Initialize c_l1 as a zero-filled nested list with shape 1 x (2*n - 1) x 2 using the same three nested loop structure used for c_l. RESULT c_l1]
            [COMMAND Set x1 = 0 and y1 = 0, then store maze[0][0] in c_l1[0][0] by assigning c_l1[0][0][0] = maze[x1][y1][0] and c_l1[0][0][1] = maze[x1][y1][1]. RESULT c_l1]
            [COMMAND For i from 0 through 2*n - 3 inclusive, update the position using the shuffled l: if l[i] is 'S', increment y1 and copy maze[x1][y1] into c_l1[0][i+1]; if l[i] is 'E', increment x1 and copy maze[x1][y1] into c_l1[0][i+1]. RESULT c_l1]
            [COMMAND While check is True, first set check = False, then scan i from 0 through 2*n - 3 inclusive and set check = True if the directed edge from c_l[0][i] to c_l[0][i+1] exactly equals the directed edge from c_l1[0][i] to c_l1[0][i+1] in both x and y coordinates. RESULT check]
            [COMMAND Inside the while loop, whenever check is True after the edge scan, randomly shuffle l, reinitialize c_l1 as an empty list, rebuild it as a 1 x (2*n - 1) x 2 zero-filled nested list, reset x1 = 0 and y1 = 0, store maze[0][0] in c_l1[0][0], and walk through the shuffled l again by incrementing y1 on 'S' or x1 on 'E' and recording each maze[x1][y1] into c_l1[0][i+1] for i from 0 through 2*n - 3 inclusive. RESULT c_l1]
            [COMMAND Print the accepted shuffled list l as a single string with no separator using print(''.join(l)). RESULT l]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
